commands.name: search-documents
commands.summary: Search published Federal Register documents by keyword, with optional filters for type, agency, publication date and significance, plus sort and paging

commands.name: get-document
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one Federal Register document by its document number: abstract, action, dates, CFR references, dockets and full-text links

commands.name: get-documents
commands.summary: Get metadata for several Federal Register documents at once, given a comma-separated list of document numbers

commands.name: count-documents-by-facet
commands.summary: Count documents matching a search, grouped by agency, document type, topic, section or publication period (facet counts)

commands.name: export-documents-csv
commands.summary: Export documents matching a search as CSV text (document number, title, type, date, agencies, citation, URLs)

commands.name: list-agencies
commands.summary: List all Federal Register agencies with id, slug, short name, parent and child agencies

commands.name: get-agency
commands.summary: Get one agency's details (description, short name, logo, parent/child agencies, recent-documents link) by slug or numeric id

commands.name: list-current-public-inspection
commands.summary: List documents currently on public inspection, which are filed but not yet published in the Federal Register

commands.name: list-public-inspection-by-date
commands.summary: List the documents that were on public inspection on a given date

commands.name: get-public-inspection-document
commands.summary: Get one public inspection document by document number: filing time, scheduled publication date, PDF and raw-text links

commands.name: list-suggested-searches
commands.summary: List curated topic searches (e.g. Dodd-Frank, stock trading), grouped by section, with saved search conditions and recent document counts

commands.name: get-suggested-search
commands.summary: Get one curated topic search by slug, including its description and the search conditions to reuse with search-documents

commands.name: get-image
commands.summary: Get metadata and download URLs (large, medium, original size) for an image embedded in a Federal Register document
